note: Thresholds, calibrated 2026-10-11 against pairs the user and the lead judged by eye (score: 0 = nothing alike, 1 = the same picture; see distinctness.py for how it is computed).

colour sets (resources, miniatures, roundels, cities, wonders, portraits): score = 1 - gap/40, gap = mean CIE Lab Delta E over the content in the worst of normal, protan, deutan, tritan and greyscale sight. Threshold 0.60 = a mean difference under 16 Delta E. Calibration: the old Coal and Iron medallions (the user's complaint) scored 0.70 at 14 px, 0.69 at 24 and 0.67 at 32, and the lookalike unit pairs the user and the UI review named (Cuirassier/Horseman 0.75, Cataphract/Horseman 0.69, Archer/Composite Archer 0.71) all score above 0.60, while pairs that read apart at a glance (Wheat/Stone 0.54, Spearman/Tank 0.14) sit below 0.45. The sets of whole-scene paintings (cities, wonders, portraits, era art) have no safe automatic bar, so they are report-only ('advisory').

mono sets (single-colour icons, seals, emblems): score = 0.6 * SSIM + 0.4 * silhouette IoU. Threshold 0.70. Calibration: Cataphract/Horseman icons (0.85 at 16 px) and the old Composite Archer/Ranger bows scored above it; the pairs that sit just under (Castle/Roadworks 0.66, Inference Core/Star Fort 0.66, Capital/City 0.63) read apart at 24 px by eye.

units-roundel: roundels are class symbols, so roundels of one class may match ('groups'); across classes the threshold is 0.80 (it is higher because the owner disc and plate are shared and dilute the score).
A pair listed in 'accepted' is a judged exception with its reason. Add one only after looking at the pair on the map at the size it is drawn; otherwise repaint the newcomer.

gist: for painted figures the silhouette alone is also compared (cropped to its bounding box, 12 x 12 coverage grid times aspect agreement), because two upright figures with a vertical spear share a silhouette at play size even when colour and detail differ (Phalangite beside Spartan Hoplite, which the user could not tell apart in play, scores 0.67 and Phalangite beside Pikeman 0.78, while mean Delta E alone scored them 0.38 and 0.66; Cuirassier/Horseman and Cataphract/Horseman score 0.88). units-miniature flags at gist 0.77. About 80 of the 528 figure pairs reach 0.67, so no silhouette bar can separate the Hoplite and Phalangite without also flagging most upright foot soldiers: that pair needs a non-silhouette cue (an era badge, a pose or a strength mark), which the unit-distinct work owns.

unlock-art: the painted diorama set shares one ground oval, so every pair starts near 0.5 and the closest retained pairs read apart at a glance; the bar is 0.66. 'watch' lists name sibling groups (libraries, forts, works) whose pairs are printed in the report whether or not they are flagged.
